limen.layer: Managed research workflow plus snapshot/event execution
limen.computation: Full snapshot is admitted to the common zero-cost replay; historical fitted-preparation reuse reduced fit counts without a demonstrated whole-campaign speedup.
limen.academic: Native temporal research, selection statistics and reserved-holdout machinery; a reproduced batch-quantile predictor violation and restricted holdout compatibility limit the relevant paths.
limen.safety: Research record/integrity and account controls coexist with reproduced resolver and manifest-read boundaries, inconsistent direct cost admission and a static nonfinite-parameter liveness defect.

lean.layer: Full local market/algorithm/account engine and optimizer
lean.computation: Pinned launcher builds, including locked NuGet restore; common-contract execution latency remains unmeasured.
lean.academic: Native algorithm-time/history guards and portfolio diagnostics; reported PSR is a marginal statistic and does not include search-family deflation.
lean.safety: Buying-power/resource/storage controls are real and route-dependent; a bounded native reproduction confirms path escape in the public ZIP overwrite helper.

backtrader.layer: Strategy, broker, feed and indicator execution framework
backtrader.computation: Full Cerebro replay is admitted; preload/runonce, exactbars and optimization multiprocessing are distinct native tradeoffs.
backtrader.academic: Default event/indicator chronology has concrete controls, while cheat modes, external reads and user-owned research stages require explicit contracts.
backtrader.safety: Native cash/submission checks and cancellation behavior are scoped controls; arbitrary strategy code remains trusted and durable research governance is an adapter responsibility.

vectorbt.layer: Public-source array portfolio and parameter/indicator toolkit
vectorbt.computation: Native Numba from_signals replay is admitted, including lazy common-output extraction; first/JIT and warm results are separate.
vectorbt.academic: Optional rolling/expanding splits and DSR calculation; input signals, lookahead discipline and complete selection history remain caller-owned.
vectorbt.safety: Detailed native order-domain checks, with native sentinel/rebate/rejection choices; trusted-object serialization is not an authenticated research manifest.

backtesting_py.layer: Bar broker/strategy execution and parameter optimizer
backtesting_py.computation: Full FractionalBacktest replay is admitted; mandatory native statistics and representation conversion remain in its timed work.
backtesting_py.academic: The core slices registered data/indicators; the percentage trailing helper changes all 153 mature stop distances under a real-prefix extension probe.
backtesting_py.safety: Native affordability/cost controls are present; optional helper chronology and trusted strategy execution remain separate boundaries.

zipline.layer: Calendar/asset-aware algorithm engine and Pipeline factors
zipline.computation: Pinned zipline-reloaded source builds/imports; no matching native hourly calendar/bundle adapter was admitted for this campaign.
zipline.academic: Substantial point-in-time pricing/event-loader machinery and local rolling estimators; model-selection folds and final holdout governance require another layer.
zipline.safety: Native CSV/tar ingestion checks and optional trading controls; control registration, log-versus-raise behavior and provider ownership matter.

freqtrade.layer: Crypto execution/backtest platform, hyperopt and FreqAI research
freqtrade.computation: Pinned source builds/imports; data preprocessing and batched joblib optimization are implemented, but matching execution and research timings remain unmeasured.
freqtrade.academic: Optional lookahead/recursive diagnostics and FreqAI temporal workflow; label-horizon, inner-validation and search-selection assumptions need explicit auditing.
freqtrade.safety: Wallet, authentication and operational controls are scoped; arbitrary strategies are trusted and prediction-mask/cache admission requires care.

nautilus.layer: Native event/actor/account engine and optional durable event store
nautilus.computation: Pinned v2 source is assessed; native test compilation timed out twice before completion. No runtime throughput or older-release figure is substituted.
nautilus.academic: Availability-time replay and canonical result bytes provide concrete primitives; they do not establish complete input identity, research isolation or market calibration.
nautilus.safety: Configured risk gates and transactional/hash-verified redb persistence are substantive; bypass, backend selection and trusted callbacks delimit enforcement.

bt.layer: Hierarchical portfolio allocation and account simulation
bt.computation: Source-compiled Cython portfolio replay is admitted, including native ffn statistics; a single-asset result does not establish tree/grid scaling.
bt.academic: Native trailing portfolio estimators operate on bounded histories; supervised research, multiple-search correction and final holdout require an adapter.
bt.safety: Targeted finite-cost/state-preservation checks and bounded allocation iteration; direct transaction, borrowing and fixed-income semantics need a declared account contract.

qstrader.layer: Daily portfolio workflow; native broker/portfolio components measured
qstrader.computation: Hourly broker/portfolio component replay is admitted; the benchmark supplies the driver, so no full-engine Limen duration ratio is assigned.
qstrader.academic: A public prehistory getter returns the final future quote; native first-peak drawdown handling also has a source-level issue. Native daily output conventions need alignment.
qstrader.safety: The prehistory probe and an insufficient-cash one-unit fill are reproduced; the latter fails a required cash-only policy, with borrowing treated separately.

hftbacktest.layer: Specialist recorded order-book, queue and latency replay
hftbacktest.computation: Native library tests pass 22/22 after dependency lock capture; no suitable recorded-depth workload was admitted, so there is no false OHLC speed ranking.
hftbacktest.academic: Distinct local/exchange clocks and queue/fill models are meaningful; venue calibration, sampling/return units and general research governance remain separate obligations.
hftbacktest.safety: Native replay/state behavior is inspected and library tests ran; malformed NPY/read-thread liveness counterexamples remain inspected, not executed hangs.

qlib.layer: Model/dataset/task research platform; exchange/position components measured
qlib.computation: Native Exchange/Position replay passes the common trace contract; full executor, provider, training and recorder throughput are unmeasured.
qlib.academic: Train-bounded processors, segmented datasets and horizon-aware rolling tasks make it a close research-workflow comparator; static and rolling paths have different leakage guards.
qlib.safety: Native guarded paths coexist with trusted configuration/artifacts; AsyncCaller was reproduced returning normally after worker failure and leaving later work unexecuted.

jesse.layer: Crypto minute replay, optimization and research helpers
jesse.computation: Pinned Python source and declared native dependency import; Ray candle sharing and Rust kernels are inspected, with no relabelled-hourly minute benchmark.
jesse.academic: Separate training/testing metrics and optional stationary-bootstrap rule testing; exposed testing feedback is not a protected final holdout or full search-family correction.
jesse.safety: Native account and operational controls have explicit limits; strategy/module paths, pickle cache ownership and dashboard-versus-research persistence are separate scopes.
